evidence.summary: CASI describes the Air Force Harbin Flight Academy as one of the PLA Air Force’s three flight academies, organised like an operational air unit and under the Northern Theater Command Air Force, which trains transport, bomber and tanker crews and fighter and ground-attack pilots.
The academy comes under the Northern Theater Command Air Force.
